0.original: Lock up your arcanists and hide the heavy equipment, Master Gegeruju is feeling bored.

1.original: Master Gegeruju's idea is refreshingly harmless. In order to call up the winds, first collect three cores from wind sprites.

2.original: You collected three wind sprite cores. Place them at the tip of the nearby cliffs to summon a storm sprite.

3.original: Nature is not to be trifled with─the storm sprite attacks you. Report to Master Gegeruju.

4.original: Far from apologetic, Master Gegeruju pouts that he only felt a whiffle. There is no greater adventure than serving at his pleasure.

25.original: Place the wind sprite cores at the tip of the cliffs.

48.original: Excellent timing, come, come! Such a still, wilting day and I had a thought─a little thought, a violet not a rose─to call up a refreshing breeze.

49.original: The wind sprites now, you can get a healthy puff or two out of them. It follows that a powerful sprite can set a whole city aflutter!

50.original: According to my best calculations─or rather my <hex:021A020203>second<hex:021A020103> best calculations, no need to ask how or why─collecting three cores from wind sprites should permit you to summon a more powerful specimen.

51.original: Won't someone─present company definitely included─carry out my genius plan? Will someone deign to collect this handsome reward?

59.original: So only <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> enjoyed a refreshing buffeting? I had but a whimpering whiffle! Oh, phooey, now I shall be bored again.
